Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class SceneContent

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.SceneContent
public final class SceneContent extends Object
Immutable selection of geometry retained in a derived scene. Content selection can only narrow available evidence; repeated entity selections intersect. Removed geometry is unavailable to camera, reflection and shadow rays. To hide geometry only from camera output while retaining its lighting and shadows, use RenderLayer.entities(EntitySelector) and RenderLayer.occlusion(Occlusion) instead.

World environment is separate from block geometry: entitiesOnly() removes block geometry while retaining captured time, weather, sampled light levels and other environment facts. Capture exclusions and viewer privacy remain authoritative in every derived scene. Use RenderEnvironment for supported environment overrides.
